messages:
anya: blocking on docs PR #521. The Ruby SDK migration guide includes a streaming + functions example that assumes the server will deliver the completed function_call if the stream errors. Runtime team: is that the current behavior or do we close the stream with an error?

sam: @anya can you paste the Ruby snippet so we can be specific? reviewers flagged the wording as risky.

anya: here's what i had: 
```ruby
client.chat.stream(model: 'redwood-serve-1', messages: msgs, functions: [spec]) do |chunk|
  if chunk[:function_call] then call_tool(chunk[:function_call]) end
end
```

anya: the docs currently say "if the stream fails, the server will send the final function payload." we need a definitive runtime statement to avoid misleading customers.

igor: runtime update: current runtime DOES NOT re-run or switch to sync mode. If a streaming request hits a transient runtime error (eg GPU OOM), we emit a final error chunk using the streaming error envelope and then close the connection. No automatic server-side fallback in prod.

sam: can you confirm the error envelope shape so we can show how to detect it in the snippet? Is it an error hash with code/message/details? Also what's the HTTP status?

runtime-bot: confirmed: final stream chunk = {"type"=>"error", "code"=>"internal", "message"=>"runtime: GPU OOM", "details"=>{"transient"=>true}} then connection closed. HTTP status 500 for the request. We'll link protocol doc in the follow-up.

anya: thank you. plan for docs: 1) update the Ruby example to a minimal defensive pattern that rescues the stream error and retries once with stream:false OR calls the sync API; 2) replace the incorrect sentence with: "Current runtime closes streams with an error frame on transient failures; clients should implement retry/fallback patterns. Server-side automatic fallback is a planned feature (see roadmap)."

sam: agree. keep the inline Ruby snippet short to avoid the docs renderer flake we've seen. Put the longer example in a gist and link to it.

ci-bot: heads up: previews historically fail on large fenced streaming code blocks. Shortening snippets reduces flake.

docs-bot: preview for docs/pr-521 currently failed on branch push (renderer error parsing fenced code block). Please push the shortened snippet and note, then I'll re-run.

anya: will push two commits: (A) replace the assertive sentence with the explicit runtime behavior + roadmap callout, (B) add a tiny rescue-based Ruby example and link a gist for the full pattern.

igor: also add the exact error hash as inline literal so SDK teams can pattern-match. e.g. `{"type"=>"error", "code"=>"internal", "message"=>"runtime: GPU OOM", "details"=>{"transient"=>true}}`.

sam: once pushed, @docs-bot please queue preview and tag reviewers.

docs-bot: received push to docs/pr-521  queued preview job id 110321.

docs-bot: preview job 110321 finished  renderer succeeded on second attempt. link: https://ci.redwood/preview/110321 (status: success).

anya: thanks all. marking blocker resolved for reviewers. I'll follow up with a migration note for customers who depended on implicit fallback.

sam: nice. also add a one-liner to SDK-compatibility doc and Migration Guide to catch people who search there first.

anya: added both in the same PR. closing thread.
